payload.question: I'm ready to run the plan. The executor will read kept.json and A2_h5.json. It will then re-run the free-run train and test evaluation of A2_h5 (and R_duffing, if kept.json holds it) with the functions in silverbox_pinn.py. Finally it will overwrite silverbox/results/kept.json with the new RMSE values, keeping the existing schema. It will save a backup, kept.json.bak, before writing. Shall I proceed?

proposed_step.instruction: Execute the scientist's plan. 1) Read and print silverbox/results/kept.json in full and keep a copy as old. 2) Read and print silverbox/results/A2_h5.json, and read the source of load_excerpt, load_model, free_run and half_sample_input in silverbox/silverbox_pinn.py. 3) Using the excerpt and settings recorded in A2_h5.json, load the data and the A2_h5.pt network and run free_run on the train and test segments. Run from the project root with a 5-minute wall-clock guard. Check that the values are finite. Print TRAIN_RMSE=<float> and TEST_RMSE=<float>. 4) If kept.json holds an R_duffing entry, run the same evaluation for R_duffing.pt and R_duffing.json. Otherwise skip it and do not add one. 5) Print the old and new train and test RMSE side by side, with absolute and relative differences. Flag differences above 1%. Also compare with the A2_h5.json and summary.md values. 6) Save a backup of kept.json as kept.json.bak. Then overwrite silverbox/results/kept.json, changing only the RMSE fields (and a date field, if one exists) and keeping the same keys, key order and indent. Reload the file and verify that the keys match old and that only the intended values changed. 7) Report the old and new numbers, the fields changed, and any discrepancies. Report only numbers the tools returned.

Run free_run on the train and test segments from the project root with a 5-minute wall-clock guard. Check that the values are finite. Print TRAIN_RMSE=<float> and TEST_RMSE=<float>. 4) If kept.json holds an R_duffing entry, run the same evaluation for R_duffing.pt and R_duffing.json. Otherwise skip it. 5) Print the old and new train and test RMSE side by side, with absolute and relative differences. Flag differences above 1%. Also compare with the A2_h5.json and summary.md values. 6) Report the numbers the tools returned. State that kept.json was left unchanged.
